description.value: Alley 16 is an upscale Japanese BBQ restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver where guests grill premium cuts tableside, with the menu centred on A5 wagyu beef — the highest possible rating — alongside uni sashimi, seafood, and handcrafted sides. The concept draws on the vibrant alley-food culture of Shanghai, Beijing, and Taipei, translated into an elegant Vancouver dining room. Reservations are strongly recommended, and the kitchen takes pride in locally sourced, fresh ingredients.
